name: Exp_PPO_Cloud
summary: This EA trades based on the PPO (Percentage Price Oscillator) Cloud indicator, which uses dual smoothing methods for fast and slow PPO lines plus a signal line. It opens buy positions when the PPO crosses above the signal line from below, and sell positions when the PPO crosses below the signal line from above, with configurable stop-loss and take-profit levels.
summary_zh: 该EA基于PPO Cloud指标进行交易，使用快慢两根PPO线和信号线的交叉来产生买卖信号。当PPO从下方穿越信号线时开多仓，从上方穿越信号线时开空仓，并设有可配置的止损和止盈水平。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于PPO（百分比价格振荡器）Cloud指标，该指标是对传统MACD的改进版本，使用可自定义的平滑算法替代固定的EMA。入场条件为：当快线Ind从下方穿越信号线Sign时产生买入信号（Ind[1]>Sign[1]且Ind[0]<=Sign[0]），当快线从上方穿越信号线时产生卖出信号（Ind[1]<Sign[1]且Ind[0]>=Sign[0]）。出场条件依赖独立的止损和止盈参数，同时当反向交叉信号出现时也会平掉对应仓位（如做多时出现空头信号则平多仓）。仓位管理通过MM参数和MMMode枚举控制，支持按自由保证金、余额、亏损后余额或固定手数等五种模式计算仓位。资金管理方面，MM参数默认0.1表示仓位比例，结合不同的保证金模式实现灵活的资金分配。策略还通过IsNewBar机制确保信号只在新的K线开盘时计算，避免逐tick重复交易。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the PPO (Percentage Price Oscillator) Cloud indicator, an improved version of the traditional MACD that uses customizable smoothing algorithms instead of fixed EMAs. Entry conditions are: a buy signal is generated when the fast line Ind crosses above the signal line Sign (Ind[1]>Sign[1] and Ind[0]<=Sign[0]), and a sell signal is generated when the fast line crosses below the signal line (Ind[1]<Sign[1] and Ind[0]>=Sign[0]). Exit conditions rely on separate stop-loss and take-profit parameters (default 1000 and 2000 points respectively), while opposing crossover signals also trigger position closure (e.g., a bearish crossover closes long positions). Position sizing is controlled through the MM parameter and MMMode enumeration, supporting five modes: free margin-based, balance-based, loss-free margin-based, loss-balance-based, and fixed lot sizing. Money management uses the MM parameter (default 0.1) as a position ratio combined with different margin modes for flexible capital allocation. The strategy also employs the IsNewBar mechanism to ensure signals are only calculated at new bar openings, preventing redundant tick-by-tick trading.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 仓位比例，用于计算交易手数
parameters.description_en: Money management ratio, controls trade lot size

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 资金管理模式：自由保证金/余额/亏损后余额/亏损后余额/固定手数
parameters.description_en: Lot calculation mode: Fixed lot or margin-based ratio

parameters.name: IPC
parameters.description: 应用于指标计算的价格类型
parameters.description_en: Applied price type for indicator calculation

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 用于获取交易信号的K线索引

pros: 使用PPO Cloud指标替代传统MACD，提供更多平滑算法选择（JJMA、JurX、ParMA、T3、VIDYA、AMA等），适应不同市场环境
具备完整的多空双向交易控制开关，可以灵活启用或禁用开仓和平仓方向
采用IsNewBar机制防止同一根K线内重复交易，避免过度交易
止损止盈参数齐全，默认止损1000点止盈2000点，盈亏比2:1较为合理
支持五种资金管理模式，灵活性较高
pros_en: Uses PPO Cloud indicator instead of traditional MACD, offering multiple smoothing algorithm choices (JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, AMA) to adapt to different market conditions
Provides complete bidirectional trading control switches, allowing flexible enabling or disabling of opening and closing in each direction
Employs IsNewBar mechanism to prevent redundant trades within the same bar, avoiding overtrading
Full stop-loss and take-profit parameters with default SL 1000 and TP 2000 points, giving a reasonable 2:1 reward-risk ratio
Supports five money management modes with high flexibility
cons: 止损1000点和止盈2000点默认值偏大，在短线交易中可能导致较大单笔亏损
没有点差过滤机制，在点差较大时仍可能开仓，增加交易成本
指标自定义调用（iCustom）依赖外部PPO_Cloud指标文件，若缺失则EA无法运行且错误提示不够友好
缺乏移动止损或保本止损机制，无法锁定浮动利润
信号逻辑简单（仅依赖PPO交叉），在震荡行情中容易产生频繁的虚假信号
cons_en: Default stop-loss of 1000 points and take-profit of 2000 points are relatively large, potentially leading to significant single-trade losses in short-term trading
No spread filter mechanism; trades may still be opened during high-spread conditions, increasing transaction costs
Custom indicator call (iCustom) depends on external PPO_Cloud indicator file; if missing, the EA fails to run with insufficient error messaging
Lacks trailing stop or break-even mechanism, unable to lock in floating profits
Simple signal logic (relying only on PPO crossover) is prone to frequent false signals in ranging markets
improvements: 增加点差过滤和波动率过滤，避免在高点差或低波动时段开仓
添加移动止损或保本止损功能，在价格有利移动后锁定利润
增加趋势过滤器（如更高时间周期的均线方向），避免在震荡行情中频繁交易
增加持仓检查逻辑，避免同方向重复开仓
improvements_en: Add spread filter and volatility filter to avoid opening positions during high-spread or low-volatility periods
Add trailing stop or break-even functionality to lock in profits after favorable price movement
Add a trend filter (e.g., higher timeframe MA direction) to avoid frequent trading in ranging markets
Add position checking logic to prevent duplicate openings in the same direction

risk_points: 默认止损1000点较大，在极端行情中可能造成显著亏损
没有点差过滤，高点差环境下交易成本可能过高
依赖外部自定义指标文件，若指标缺失则EA初始化失败
震荡行情中PPO交叉信号容易产生连续亏损
risk_points_en: Default stop-loss of 1000 points is large and may cause significant losses in extreme market conditions
No spread filter; trading costs may be excessive in high-spread environments
Depends on external custom indicator file; EA initialization fails if the indicator is missing
PPO crossover signals in ranging markets can easily produce consecutive losses
